request: Export a human-readable Markdown report alongside existing JSON; Markdown is the primary share and raw JSON/serial are secondary.
source: User request and coordinator validation results; documentation author read frozen source and verified final file hashes. Actual Foundation Swift checks await the Apple gate.

host_validation.source: Coordinator full suite and independent focused reviewer run; source/compile-visible review found no blocker.
host_validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/workspace/iDeck/.work python3 -m unittest discover -s experiments/linux-guest/tests -v
host_validation.boundary: Python tests cover actual package plist/source/staging behavior and preserve real overlay inputs; no local Swift renderer execution, Apple IPA build or app Markdown device test.

implementation.renderer_scope: Pure Foundation/CoreFoundation allowlisted renderer; no file, pairing or runtime access. Typed booleans/numbers/hash/status validation, unknown stays UNKNOWN, bounded escaped text and no unknown-field appendix.
implementation.serial_scope: Optional at most 2 MiB serial snapshot; include only whole-line fixed allowlisted probe markers and bounded kernel release token, never arbitrary serial suffixes/log lines.
implementation.snapshot_writes: LinuxProbeSession.saveReport atomically writes unchanged raw field set plus added reporting metadata to result.json, then renders/writes Markdown atomically from the same report snapshot.
implementation.failure_behavior: JSON write failure invalidates Markdown then propagates as before. Markdown-only write failure removes/marks unavailable stale Markdown, displays export error, leaves guest outcome and existing raw JSON/log sharing intact.
implementation.share_ui: Save report menu uses Markdown-only primary action; Raw JSON and serial log is a separate secondary action filtered to existing files.
implementation.new_metadata: App version/source commit, generic device class, pre-start execution check, profile dimensions/resources and whole-line Linux init/completion observations. Generic class is not a device serial number.
implementation.package_declaration: Import net.daringfireball.markdown as UTF-8 text with md extension/text/markdown MIME; use file URL sharing.
implementation.apple_gate: Fifth Swift source restored through overlay; actual Foundation renderer checks wired into existing Mac/Apple validation gate, not executed locally.

one_off_existing_report_markdown_deliver.source: Coordinator confirmation that the owner current report was separately converted to Markdown and delivered.

source_staging.source: Coordinator actual pinned restore/full overlay/fifth-source/all input hashes check; overlay hash directly verified by evidence author.

next_step: Coordinator reviews, commits/pushes and verifies exact remote SHA, then runs only one approved Apple workflow after fresh quota/private/disabled-billing checks. That gate must compile/run the real Foundation checks, typecheck the fifth source, build a new IPA and retain device export validation as separate work.
